summary: Iteration 11 — verified pending driver visibility/search, cancel-with-refund, admin mark-refunded, change-driver reassignment (no-double-charge), and Track UI states (manage / searching / refund). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering cancel(paid & unpaid), admin refund happy+error path, change-driver → quoting/reassignments[]/driver freed/payment preserved, and select-driver reassignment with NO source_id keeping payment.status='paid' + transaction_id unchanged (proving Square is NOT called). Frontend: admin drivers tab shows pending row with email + 0/4 docs + Approve, driver-search filters to that row; admin-job-modal opens on cancelled row and shows admin-refund-box with 'Refund requested' → clicking admin-mark-refunded flips to Refunded; customer /track/{id} shows track-manage on assigned booking, track-searching on quoting-paid, track-refund-status on cancelled-paid; ReasonDialog opens on change-driver, confirm hits API + navigates to /jobs; MyJobs Accept on the already-paid reassigned booking assigns WITHOUT opening any payment modal / Square iframe.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (not a bug for this iteration): POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/assign sets payment.status='office' (not 'paid'). The 'no-double-charge' reassignment path in _assign_and_pay checks status=='paid'. That means admin-assigned bookings could NOT be safely re-selected without a card token. For tests we set payment.status='paid' via Mongo to simulate a Square-paid booking. Consider either (a) treating 'office' as already_paid to avoid a double charge if the customer later requests change-driver on an office booking, OR (b) leaving as-is and never exposing change-driver to office bookings on the customer UI. Currently the customer /track page shows Change driver on ANY assigned booking regardless of payment type — an office booking that goes through change-driver → select-driver would fail with 'Payment details required' unless credit covers it.
server.py at 1309 lines — still recommend splitting into auth/admin/driver/bookings modules.

cancel_booking uses pay.get('card_charged', pay.get('amount', 0)) for refund amount — for office bookings (amount 0) refund would be £0 which is correct (no card to refund), but the customer UI still shows 'Refund requested — we'll process this back to your card' which could confuse a cash/office customer. Consider gating the refund UI on pay.type !== 'office'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoints verified: POST /bookings/{id}/cancel (paid → payment.refund.status='requested' + amount=card_charged + reason; unpaid → refund_requested=false; driver freed via availability='available'); POST /bookings/{id}/change-driver (assigned+has-driver → status='quoting', driver_id/driver cleared, reassignments[] pushed with prev_driver_id+reason, timeline appended, previous driver's availability='available', payment.status preserved); POST /admin/bookings/{id}/refund (requires refund.status='requested', flips to 'refunded' + processed_at, 400 otherwise); POST /bookings/{id}/select-driver with only {driver_id} on an already-paid booking triggers already_paid branch in _assign_and_pay (no Square call, transaction_id preserved). Frontend test-ids verified: driver-row-<id>, driver-email-<id>, docs-<id>, driver-search, approve-<id>, admin-job-modal, admin-refund-box, admin-mark-refunded, track-manage, track-change-driver, track-cancel, track-searching, track-choose-driver, track-refund-status, reason-dialog, reason-<slug>, reason-confirm. Because Square is LIVE, to reproduce a paid state without charging a card, use seed_iter11.py's _mongo_set_payment_paid helper (writes {status:'paid', transaction_id:'TEST_TXN_...'} directly to db.bookings). Admin manual-assign alone sets payment.status='office' which does NOT satisfy _assign_and_pay's already_paid check — flagged in review comments.
